name: StitchedCompare
job: Compare two photos (before/after, old/new) across a divider that is a visible stitched seam you drag, with thread tension animating as you pull
visitor_action: drag the seam; arrow keys nudge; tap a side to jump
mobile: full-width, large drag handle, seam stays vertical
motion: stitches stretch and settle with spring as the seam moves (reduced-motion: seam moves with no stretch)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Tailor's table: oatmeal linen frame with blue and white tailor's chalk marks, selvedge tapes, waxed madder-red cross-lacing, sewn-on button handle, pinned paper labels
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo (Sonnet 5.5) after Guy's 'ugly' verdict: seam rebuilt as waxed madder thread (ply twist, sheen, per-stitch spring twang), scalloped selvedge tapes with needle-hole pucker, button handle, pinned Caveat labels, chalked linen table. Still never seen in a browser (render/craft gates skipped by directive), so proportions and mid-drag frames are unverified visually. Default before/after photos are two different rooms. | 2026-11-23: QA nit fixes. At <=540px the pinned tags shrink (30cqw, 16px ink) and tuck into the top corners clear of the seam; removed the decorative chalk top dot-row and the x/o chalk marks (elements + CSS). Verified in headless Chrome at 375. 2026-11-24: de-skeuomorphic pass: thread sheen/glint/ridges reduced, chalk ruler removed, labels flattened (no folded corner/noise) with a plain pin head; per-stitch spring seam kept.
